lesson.title: Compare the opening
lesson.subtitle: Smaller, equal, or larger?
lesson.story: Imagine fitting the reference square corner inside angle A. Compare the openings.
lesson.objective: Compare an angle with a right angle.

steps.title: Compare with a right angle
steps.prompt: How does angle A compare with a right angle?
hints: Look at the space between the two arms.
The reference corner shows a right angle.
A square corner fits inside angle A with space left over.
Choose: Larger than a right angle.

steps.title: Explain your thinking
steps.prompt: What matters when you compare angles?

choices.label: Turning the whole card around makes the angle on it larger or smaller.
The opening between the arms matters, even when the angle is turned.

hints: Think about what stayed the same.
Use the relationship you just checked.
